bullets.text: Metrowater officials reported a road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity that halted traffic, and the office should monitor restoration work.

Young people engaged in dangerous bike racing on Ambattur and Thirumangalam roads in viral videos, and the office should track police action.
L&T's Vyoma AI started construction on a 52 MW liquid-cooled data centre near Chennai, and the office should watch for digital infrastructure growth.
Rising AI and cloud computing demand is driving India's data centre capacity toward 2 GW in 2026, and the office should support digital expansion.
